title: Split Decision
description: Fill the left half of the canvas with crimson (0.9, 0.22, 0.27) and the right half with midnight navy (0.1, 0.13, 0.25). The edge between them is a hard cut at the middle, with no blending.
hintText: step(edge, x) gives 0.0 before the edge and 1.0 after it. Feed it to mix() to pick between the two colors.
